790710102.text: My colleagues have apprised me of your names and deeds, and have confirmed that you are valiant indeed.

790710103.text: Were I not in charge of training the guards, I should have liked to spar with you.

790710104.text: So you're a guard yourself, then?

790710105.text: In sooth, I am. On the orders of our liege, we are to defend Constellation Metropole and keep the peace.

790710106.text: My work, specifically, is to train the guards, that their skills may prove worthy of their duty.

790710107.text: So the door behind leads to the training grounds?

790710108.text: Keen-eyed indeed! It leads to a Domain that we just finished remodeling.

790710109.text: Within those grounds, the trainee must swing their blade to a specific rhythm, and the arena's lighting will constantly change throughout the battle.

790710110.text: Sounds like some pretty rigorous training...

790710111.text: Sounds complicated, more like... Do you have to follow that specific rhythm while fighting as well?

790710112.text: This part of the regimen is actually derived from a story titled "The Owl Musician."

790710113.text: It was popular amongst the guards some time back. Many enjoyed it to the point where they'd forget to take part in training, and their daily patrols were delayed.

790710114.text: But I had a thought. Since everyone liked it so much, adding elements of the story into our training would make it more enjoyable.

790710115.text: It has had a visible effect on training... if nothing else, there have been no further delays in our patrols due to personal reasons.

790710116.text: Hehe... Would the two of you be interested in said training?

790710117.text: The challenges within should be a piece of cake for those with valor such as yours.

790710119.text: Such commendable courage! Excellent. Please, then, step into the Domain.

790710121.text: Understandable. Come back whenever you have the time — I will be standing guard here.
